mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior 30 days signals an accommodative monetary policy shift, compressing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined by at least 0.5 percentage points over the prior 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.5%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both INDPRO and HOUST have declined by at least 0.5% over the prior 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), rising inflation erodes real corporate profits and prompts aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the prior 30 days signals robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS has increased by at least 0.5% over the prior 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 900,000 units, it indicates a weakening housing market that reduces construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 900.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a policy response to stagflation, increasing uncertainty and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL has risen by at least 0.5% and FEDFUNDS has fallen by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: In an industrial contraction regime (INDPRO < 100), a decline in manufacturing output signals a broad economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100.
